_comment: Copy to runner/servers.json (keep it private: it may hold API keys). `body` = the model under test, selected per trial/series with --body <key>. `small` = the auxiliary model for OpenCode's hidden title/summary agents (not used for the work itself); the runner takes the first one that answers. request_extras are sent in every request body (here: the thinking setting and the thinking budget read by budget_proxy.py).

example-via-budget-proxy.name: Model under test, through the thinking-budget proxy

smoke.name: any small model for a smoke test
